description: This file contains platform-specific functions for checking and performing system upgrades on certain hardware boards, notably 'netgear,wg302v1'. It defines functions to verify image compatibility and to execute upgrade procedures based on the board type.

methods.name: platform_check_image
methods.description: Checks whether the uploaded image is compatible with the current hardware board.

methods.name: platform_do_upgrade
methods.description: Performs the upgrade procedure for supported hardware boards.
